local function ClearLine(a,b)
	local r=workspace:Raycast(a,b-a,RayParams)

local function ClearFromTool(toolPos,targetPos)
	local r=workspace:Raycast(toolPos,targetPos-toolPos,RayParams)
	return not r
end

local function AvoidTools(pos)
	local newPos=pos
	for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Tool") then
			local handle=obj:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then
				local flatPos=Vector3.new(newPos.X,handle.Position.Y,newPos.Z)
				if (flatPos-handle.Position).Magnitude<3 then
					newPos=newPos+Camera.CFrame.RightVector*6
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return newPos
end

local function Ground(pos)
	local r=workspace:Raycast(pos+Vector3.new(0,40,0),Vector3.new(0,-200,0),RayParams)
	if r then
		local p=r.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
		return AvoidTools(p)
	else
		return AvoidTools(pos+Vector3.new(0,3,0))
	end
end

local function PickupTool(tool)

local function EnsureNotOnTool(target,toolPos)
	local flatTarget=Vector3.new(target.X,toolPos.Y,target.Z)
	if (flatTarget-toolPos).Magnitude<2 then
		local alt=Ground(toolPos+Camera.CFrame.RightVector*5)
		if math.abs(alt.Y-toolPos.Y)<=6 and ClearFromTool(toolPos,alt) then
			return alt
		end
		local alt2=Ground(toolPos-Camera.CFrame.RightVector*5)
		if math.abs(alt2.Y-toolPos.Y)<=6 and ClearFromTool(toolPos,alt2) then
			return alt2
		end
	end
	return target
end

local function BestSide(toolPos)
	local hrp=Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local baseY=toolPos.Y
	if not hrp then
		local g=Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY+3,toolPos.Z)
		return EnsureNotOnTool(AvoidTools(g),toolPos)
	end
	local sides={
		Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)+Camera.CFrame.RightVector*5,
		Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)-Camera.CFrame.RightVector*5,
		Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)+Camera.CFrame.LookVector*5,
		Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)-Camera.CFrame.LookVector*5
	}
	local best=nil
	local bestDist=math.huge
	for _,pos in ipairs(sides) do
		local g=AvoidTools(pos)
		if math.abs(g.Y-baseY)<=2 then
			if ClearFromTool(toolPos,g) then
				local d=(g-hrp.Position).Magnitude
				if d<bestDist then
					bestDist=d
					best=g
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if best then
		return EnsureNotOnTool(best,toolPos)
	end
	local fallback=Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)
	return EnsureNotOnTool(AvoidTools(fallback),toolPos)
end

local function SafeTP(tool)
	local hrp=Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if not hrp or not handle then return end
	local target=BestSide(handle.Position)
	target=AvoidTools(target)
	hrp.CFrame=CFrame.new(target,hrp.Position+hrp.CFrame.LookVector)
end

local function TPAndPickup(tool)

	task.wait(0.5)

local function GetRoot()
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end

	return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function ProcessCrate(crate)
	if not AutoGetCrates then
		return
	end

	if not crate:IsA("Model") or crate.Name ~= "Crate" then
		return
	end

	local rootPart = GetRoot()
	if not rootPart then
		return
	end

	-- Get the crate's position
	local crateCFrame

	if crate.PrimaryPart then
		crateCFrame = crate.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	else
		crateCFrame = crate:GetPivot()
	end

	-- Teleport 10 studs underneath the crate
	local targetPosition =
		crateCFrame.Position - Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)

	rootPart.CFrame =
		CFrame.new(targetPosition) *
		(rootPart.CFrame - rootPart.CFrame.Position)

	-- Find Effects.Basic Flame Wisp
	local effects = crate:FindFirstChild("Effects", true)
	local basic = effects and effects:FindFirstChild("Basic")
	local flameWisp = basic and basic:FindFirstChild("Flame Wisp")

	-- Wait until Flame Wisp is disabled
	if flameWisp and flameWisp:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		while AutoGetCrates
			and crate.Parent
			and flameWisp.Enabled do

			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end

	if not AutoGetCrates or not crate.Parent then
		return
	end

	-- Find GetItemFromCrate
	local remote = crate:FindFirstChild("GetItemFromCrate", true)

	if not remote then
		warn("GetItemFromCrate not found in crate:", crate:GetFullName())
		return
	end

	if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		remote:FireServer()

	elseif remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
		remote:InvokeServer()
	end
end

ItemsTab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "Auto Get Crates [NOT FINSIHED]",
	CurrentValue = false,

		AutoGetCrates = Value

		if not Value then
			return

		local shipments = workspace:FindFirstChild("Shipments")
		local cratesFolder = shipments and shipments:FindFirstChild("Crates")

		if not cratesFolder then
			Rayfield:Notify({
				Title = "Auto Get Crates",
				Content = "Workspace.Shipments.Crates not found.",
				Duration = 5
			})
			return
		end

		-- Process crates that already exist
		for _, crate in ipairs(cratesFolder:GetChildren()) do
			task.spawn(function()
				ProcessCrate(crate)
			end)
		end

		-- Process newly spawned crates
		task.spawn(function()

			while AutoGetCrates and cratesFolder.Parent do

				local connection

				connection = cratesFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(crate)
					if AutoGetCrates
						and crate:IsA("Model")
						and crate.Name == "Crate" then

						task.spawn(function()
							ProcessCrate(crate)
						end)
					end
				end)

				repeat
					task.wait(1)
				until not AutoGetCrates or not cratesFolder.Parent

				if connection then
					connection:Disconnect()
				end
			end
		end)
	end
})

local function GetGloveValue(player)
	local glove = player:FindFirstChild("Glove")

	if not glove then
		return nil
	end

	-- Supports StringValue and similar Value objects
	local success, value = pcall(function()
		return glove.Value
	end)

	if success and value ~= nil then
		return tostring(value)
	end

	return nil
end

	local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")

	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)

	local playerESP = head:FindFirstChild("PlayerESP")

	if not playerESP then

	local gloveLabel = playerESP:FindFirstChild("Glove")

		gloveLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

		gloveLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		gloveLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)

		gloveLabel.TextScaled = true
		gloveLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		gloveLabel.Parent = playerESP
	end

	local gloveValue = GetGloveValue(player)

	if gloveValue then
		gloveLabel.Text = gloveValue
		gloveLabel.Visible = true

local function FindAllowedTool(maxDistance)
	local currentChar = lp.Character
	local hrp = currentChar and currentChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not hrp then
		return nil
	end

	local closest = nil
	local closestDistance = maxDistance or math.huge

	for _, tool in ipairs(Items:GetChildren()) do

		if tool:IsA("Tool")
			and AllowedTools[tool.Name] then

			local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")

			if handle then

				local distance =
					(handle.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

				if distance < closestDistance then
					closestDistance = distance
					closest = tool
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end

local function CollectItems(amount)

	if CollectionRunning then
		return 0
	end

	if not GetItemsEnabled then
		return 0
	end

	if blocked or recoveryRunning then
		return 0
	end

	if not CountdownAllowed() then
		return 0
	end

	CollectionRunning = true

	local picked = 0

	local order = GetOrderedItems()

	for _, group in ipairs(order) do

		for _, tool in ipairs(group) do

			if picked >= amount then
				break
			end

			if not GetItemsEnabled then
				break
			end

			if blocked or recoveryRunning then
				break
			end

			if not CountdownAllowed() then
				break
			end

			if tool and tool.Parent then

				-- Bomb may only be teleported to once.
				if tool.Name == "Bomb"
					and BombTeleportedThisRound then

					continue
				end

				local success =
					TPWaitLookPickup(tool)

				if success then

					picked += 1

					if tool.Name == "Bomb" then

						BombPickedThisRound = true
						BombTeleportedThisRound = true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if picked >= amount then
			break
		end
	end

	CollectionRunning = false

	return picked
end

--==================================================

local function StartBusCollection()

	if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then
		return
	end

	if ContinueAfterBusRunning then
		return
	end

	ContinueAfterBusRunning = true

	-- Stop normal item collection while inside bus.
	GetItemsEnabled = false
	CollectionRunning = false
	CollectionCooldown = false
	lastPicked = nil

	task.wait(0.5)

	-- Check toggle before jumping.
	if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		GetItemsEnabled = false
		ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

		return
	end

	--==================================================
	-- JUMP OUT, THEN TELEPORT TO TOOL
	--==================================================

	if ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		-- Jump out first
		pcall(function()
			BusJumping:FireServer()
		end)

		-- Wait 0.1 seconds after jumping
		task.wait(0.1)

		if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then
			return
		end

		-- Look for a tool after the jump.
		-- Retry briefly in case the items have not loaded yet.
		local tool = nil

		for i = 1, 20 do

			if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then
				break
			end

			tool = FindAllowedTool(1000)

			if tool and tool.Parent then
				break
			end

			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		-- Teleport after the tool is found
		if ContinueAfterBusEnabled and tool and tool.Parent then
			TPToToolWithoutPickup(tool)
		end
	end

	--==================================================
	-- WAIT AFTER JUMP
	--==================================================

	task.wait(0.2)

	if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		GetItemsEnabled = false
		ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

		return
	end

	--==================================================
	-- CONFIRM PLAYER IS OUT OF BUS
	--==================================================

	local startTime = tick()
	local exitedBus = false

	while tick() - startTime < 10 do

		if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

			GetItemsEnabled = false
			ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

			return
		end

		local currentChar = lp.Character
		local torso = GetTorso(currentChar)

		if torso and torso.Transparency < 1 then

			exitedBus = true
			break
		end

		task.wait(0.05)
	end

	if not exitedBus then

		GetItemsEnabled = false
		ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

		return
	end

	--==================================================
	-- WAIT 10 SECONDS AFTER JUMPING OUT
	--==================================================

	task.wait(10)

	if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		GetItemsEnabled = false
		ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

		return
	end

	--==================================================
	-- DELETE GLIDERS WHILE GET ITEMS IS ENABLED
	--==================================================

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			if GetItemsEnabled then
				for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj.Name == "Glider" then
						pcall(function()
							obj:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- NOW TELEPORT TO BOMB
	--==================================================

	GetItemsEnabled = true

	if not BombTeleportedThisRound
		and ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		local bomb = nil

		for _, tool in ipairs(Items:GetChildren()) do

			if tool:IsA("Tool")
				and tool.Name == "Bomb"
				and tool.Parent then

				bomb = tool
				break
			end
		end

		if bomb then

			TPToToolWithoutPickup(bomb)

			BombTeleportedThisRound = true
		end
	end

	--==================================================
	-- COLLECT ITEMS
	--==================================================

	if ContinueAfterBusEnabled
		and GetItemsEnabled then

		local amount

		if CollectionCycle == 0 then
			amount = 4
		else
			amount = 7
		end

		local picked =
			CollectItems(amount)

		if picked > 0 then

			CollectionCycle += 1

			-- Always wait 5 seconds after
			-- the collection finishes.
			CollectionCooldown = true

			task.wait(5)

			CollectionCooldown = false
		end
	end

	ContinueAfterBusRunning = false
end

local function SetupBusMonitor(c)

	local leg = GetRightLeg(c)

		leg.Transparency

	leg:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
		"Transparency"
	):Connect(function()

		local currentTransparency =
			leg.Transparency

		local becameInvisible =
			previousTransparency < 1
			and currentTransparency >= 1

		previousTransparency =
			currentTransparency

		if not becameInvisible then
			return
		end

		--==================================================
		-- CONTINUE OFF
		--==================================================

		if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

			-- Stay in bus.
			GetItemsEnabled = false

			return
		end

		--==================================================
		-- CONTINUE ON
		--==================================================

		if ContinueAfterBusRunning then
			return
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			StartBusCollection()
		end)

	end)
end

local function FindClosestGetAllTool()

	local currentChar = lp.Character

	local hrp =
		currentChar
		and currentChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not hrp then
		return nil
	end

	local closest = nil
	local closestDistance = math.huge

	for _, tool in ipairs(Items:GetChildren()) do

		-- Accept EVERY Tool in workspace.Items.
		if tool:IsA("Tool") then

			local handle =
				tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")

			if handle
				and handle:IsA("BasePart")
				and handle.Parent then

				local distance =
					(handle.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

				if distance < closestDistance then

					closestDistance = distance
					closest = tool

				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end

local function TweenToGetAllTool(tool)

	if not tool or not tool.Parent then
		return false
	end

	local currentChar = lp.Character

	local hrp =
		currentChar
		and currentChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local handle =
		tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")

	if not hrp or not handle then
		return false
	end

	local targetPosition =
		handle.Position + Vector3.new(2, 0, 0)

	local targetCFrame =
		CFrame.new(
			targetPosition,
			handle.Position
		)

	local tweenInfo =
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.1,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		)

	local tween =
		TweenService:Create(
			hrp,
			tweenInfo,
			{
				CFrame = targetCFrame
			}
		)

	local finished = false

	local connection =
		tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			finished = true
		end)

	tween:Play()

	while not finished do

		if not GetAllItemsEnabled then

			tween:Cancel()

			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end

			return false
		end

		if not tool.Parent then

			tween:Cancel()

			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end

			return false
		end

		task.wait()
	end

	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	return true
end

local function StartGetAllItems()

	if GetAllItemsRunning then
		return
	end

	GetAllItemsRunning = true

	while GetAllItemsEnabled do

		-- Use the same countdown requirement.
		if CountdownAllowed() then

			-- Always get the closest remaining Tool.
			local tool =
				FindClosestGetAllTool()

			if tool then

				-- Tween to tool for 0.4 seconds.
				local arrived =
					TweenToGetAllTool(tool)

				if arrived
					and GetAllItemsEnabled
					and tool.Parent then

					-- Wait 0.4 seconds after arriving.
					task.wait(0.4)

					if GetAllItemsEnabled
						and tool.Parent then

						-- Pick it up.
						GetAllPickup(tool)

						-- Wait 2 seconds before
						-- going to the next tool.
						task.wait(2)
					end

				else
					task.wait(0.1)
				end

			else

				-- No tools currently available.
				task.wait(0.1)

			end

		else

			-- Wait for the countdown.
			task.wait(0.1)

		end
	end

	GetAllItemsRunning = false
end

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Constants
local BUTTON_SIZE = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60)
local BUTTON_Y_OFFSET = -75
local BUTTON_X_OFFSET_Q = -70
local BUTTON_X_OFFSET_E = 0
local BUTTON_X_OFFSET_R = 70
local COOLDOWN = 5
local DEFAULT_ATTACK_RADIUS = 15
local R_BOOST_SPEED = 100
local R_BOOST_DURATION = 5

-- Animations
local Q_ANIMATION = Instance.new("Animation")
Q_ANIMATION.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://16102789182"

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", PlayerGui)

-- 3D Box Hitbox Check (6x6x6 dimensions)
local function boxHitboxCheck(boxSize)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return false end

    local halfBox = boxSize / 2
    local hitAny = false

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local targetRoot = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
                local relativePos = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(targetRoot.Position)
                if math.abs(relativePos.X) <= halfBox.X and math.abs(relativePos.Y) <= halfBox.Y and math.abs(relativePos.Z) <= halfBox.Z then
                    local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GeneralHit")
                    if remote then
                        remote:FireServer(targetRoot)
                        hitAny = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return hitAny
end

-- Standard radius attack fallback for Q and E
local function radiusAttack(customRadius)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return false end

    local radius = customRadius or DEFAULT_ATTACK_RADIUS
    local hitAny = false

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local targetRoot = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot and (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
                local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GeneralHit")
                if remote then
                    remote:FireServer(targetRoot)
                    hitAny = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return hitAny
end

-- Function to create generic button GUI
local function createButton(name, text, xOffset, animation, buttonColor, soundId, onClickAction)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame", screenGui)

    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    Instance.new("UIStroke", frame).Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)

    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.ZIndex = 3

    local textButton = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
    textButton.Name = "TextButton"
    textButton.Text = ""
    textButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    textButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textButton.ZIndex = 4

    -- Sound Setup
    local sound
    if soundId then
        sound = Instance.new("Sound", frame)
        sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(soundId)
        sound.Volume = 1
    end

    local canUse = true
    textButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not canUse then return end
        canUse = false

        if sound then
            sound:Play()
        end

        local animTrack = nil
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if character then
            local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if humanoid and animation then
                local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
                animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
            end
        end

        if onClickAction then
            onClickAction(animTrack)
        else
            if animTrack then animTrack:Play() end
            radiusAttack()
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(COOLDOWN)
            canUse = true
        end)
    end)

    return frame
end

-- E Button (Blue)

-- R Button (Green) - 6x6x6 Hitbox, 2x Anim Speed, Stops Anim on Hit or Miss
createButton("RButton", "T", BUTTON_X_OFFSET_R, R_ANIMATION, Color3.fromRGB(40, 220, 40), nil, function(animTrack)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end

    -- Play animation at 2x speed
    if animTrack then
        animTrack:Play()
        animTrack:AdjustSpeed(2)
    end

    -- Persistent BodyVelocity force
    if root:FindFirstChild("RushVelocity") then
        root.RushVelocity:Destroy()
    end

    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Name = "RushVelocity"
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(100000, 0, 100000)
    bv.Velocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * R_BOOST_SPEED
    bv.Parent = root

    task.spawn(function()
        local startTime = tick()
        local moveConn

        moveConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not root or not root.Parent or not bv or not bv.Parent then
                if moveConn then moveConn:Disconnect() end
                if bv then bv:Destroy() end
                if animTrack and animTrack.IsPlaying then animTrack:Stop() end
                return
            end

            -- Drive velocity direction
            bv.Velocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * R_BOOST_SPEED

            -- 6x6x6 Hitbox Check
            local hitTarget = boxHitboxCheck(Vector3.new(6, 6, 6))
            local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime

            -- Stop velocity and animation on hit OR on miss (5 second timeout)
            if hitTarget or (elapsedTime >= R_BOOST_DURATION) then
                if moveConn then moveConn:Disconnect() end
                if bv and bv.Parent then bv:Destroy() end
                if animTrack and animTrack.IsPlaying then animTrack:Stop() end
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
            end
        end)
    end)
end)

    -- Highlight Outline

    currentHighlight = highlight

    -- Background Music Setup
    local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if rootPart then
        local music = Instance.new("Sound")
        music.Name = "BackgroundMusic"
        music.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1843512599"
        music.Volume = 0.8
        music.Looped = true
        music.Parent = rootPart
        music:Play()
        currentMusic = music
    end

    local torso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if torso then
        -- Big Black Wings
        local wings = Instance.new("Part")
        wings.Name = "BlackWings"

        wings.CanCollide = false

        local weld = Instance.new("Weld")

        weld.Part1 = wings
        weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0.75) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
        weld.Parent = wings
        
        -- Large Light Blue Ring (105, 105, 255)
        local ring = Instance.new("Part")

        ring.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 123)
        ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        ring.CanCollide = false
        ring.Massless = true
        ring.Anchored = false
        ring.Parent = char
        currentRing = ring
        
        local ringMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        ringMesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://3270017"

        local ringWeld = Instance.new("Weld")

        ringWeld.Part1 = ring
        ringWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0.55) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
        ringWeld.Parent = ring
    end

    local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if not humanoid then return end

    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)

    -- Idle Animation
    local idleAnim = Instance.new("Animation")

    local idleTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(idleAnim)
    idleTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
    idleTrack.Looped = true
    currentIdle = idleTrack

    -- Walk Animation
    local walkAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    walkAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://13548464604"
    local walkTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(walkAnim)
    walkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
    walkTrack.Looped = true
    currentWalk = walkTrack

    local function updateAnims(speed)
        if speed > 0.5 then
            if idleTrack.IsPlaying then idleTrack:Stop(0.15) end
            if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play(0.15) end
        else
            if walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop(0.15) end
            if not idleTrack.IsPlaying then idleTrack:Play(0.15) end
        end
    end

    runningConnection = humanoid.Running:Connect(updateAnims)

    if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        idleTrack:Play()
    else
        walkTrack:Play()
    end
end
